text: あんたか　あずかっていた　ポケモンを　そだてていたら……なんと！

structure.jp: あずかっていた　ポケモンを　そだてていたら……
structure.en: while we were raising the Pokémon we were keeping...

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: あずかっていた　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a thing describes that thing, like 'the ... that ...' in English. あずかっていた　ポケモン = 'the Pokémon we were keeping for you'.

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら here means 'when', leading into something unexpected that was found. そだてていたら = 'when we were raising it'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ていた says something was going on over a stretch of time in the past. あずかっていた = 'had been keeping'.
